title: 段落逻辑关系专项
passage: 段落逻辑关系专项训练：判断段落间或段落内的逻辑关系。

questions.question_text:
句1：Regular exercise improves cardiovascular health.
句2：It also helps reduce stress and improve mood.

第二句与第一句的逻辑关系是：
questions.analysis: also 表示"也"，是递进关系，补充说明运动的另一个好处。

questions.question_text:
句1：The economy showed signs of recovery last quarter.
句2：However, unemployment rates remain high.

第二句与第一句的逻辑关系是：
questions.analysis: However 表示转折，经济复苏和高失业率之间形成对比。

questions.question_text:
句1：Many species are facing extinction.
句2：For example, the giant panda's habitat has shrunk by 50% in the last 30 years.

第二句与第一句的逻辑关系是：
questions.analysis: For example 表示举例说明，用熊猫的例子说明物种灭绝问题。

questions.question_text:
句1：Due to the pandemic, many small businesses closed down.
句2：As a result, unemployment rates rose sharply.

第二句与第一句的逻辑关系是：
questions.analysis: As a result 表示结果，小企业倒闭导致失业率上升，是因果关系。

questions.question_text:
Although the study had a small sample size, its findings were consistent with previous research.

这句话中包含什么逻辑关系？
questions.analysis: Although 引导让步状语从句，表示"尽管样本量小，但研究结果与之前的研究一致"。
